# stb

Single-file public-domain libraries by Sean Barrett (https://github.com/nothings/stb),
used by plezy-xr to decode poster images (`stb_image.h` v2.30), rasterise the menu font
(`stb_truetype.h` v1.26) and write PNG screenshots of the menu (`stb_image_write.h` v1.16).
Unmodified copies from the `master` branch, fetched 2026-10-28. Each header carries its own
public-domain / MIT dual licence notice at the end of the file.
